name: Brush stroke
summary: Thick brush swash that paints itself on left to right with a dry-brush finish; a backdrop for titles.

params.name: w
params.note: stroke length (px at s = 1, without the dry streaks)

params.name: anim
params.note: paint = draws on over len frames; none = fully painted from frame 0 (when at = 0)

params.name: color
params.note: paint colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
